title: A Noetherian local ring of dimension one is regular iff it is a normal domain
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring of Krull dimension $\dim A=1$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Then $A$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] (its maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ is generated by one element) if and only if $A$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] (an integral domain integrally closed in its field of fractions).
